newsitem.title: USA: Clean Harbors says names new president.
newsitem.headline: Clean Harbors says names new president.

text.p: Clean Harbors Inc said on Thursday that David Eckert, the company's chief operating officer, would expand his duties to include the post of company president.
Eckert succeeds Alan McKim, who serves as Clean Harbors' chairman and chief executive officer.

Eckert, 42, joined Clean Harbors as executive vice president and chief operating officer in March 1996. Previously, he served as co-chairman and co-CEO of SV Corp, an international manufacturer of industrial valves, Clean Harbors said in a statement.
Clean Harbors Inc provides environmental services to customers throughout the United States.
